tldr: North Node in House 12: growth through retreat, spiritual practice, closure, dreamwork, hidden healing, and surrender.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop retreat, spiritual practice, closure, dreamwork, hidden healing, and surrender. The South Node in House 6 shows the familiar life field: overwork, fixing, control, hyper-usefulness, or health anxiety. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to protect space for what cannot be measured yet.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses retreat, spiritual practice, closure, dreamwork, hidden healing, and surrender in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 6 can pull the person back toward overwork, fixing, control, hyper-usefulness, or health anxiety.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
